name: Pinky☆Distortion
source:
The player is a girl who works at a rehearsal studio in Harajuku. Her favorite music is Visual-Kei!!
She took this job to be able to get as close as possible to her favorite music, but she still has a lot to learn.
One day, she meets a foursome Visual-Kei band called DIS;CODE.
They play great and look perfect!! But there's one problem. The band does not have a lead vocal.
"Aren't you going to recruit someone?"
starts the player off on a quest helping to look for a band vocal.

The band members then meet Hazuki, a band beginner but a singer with a very unique voice.
The game player is relieved to have successfully found a vocal, but that's not the end!
She hears, "Looking forward to working with you, personal manager!"
and ends up becoming the band's new personal manager!

[From [url=http://www.pinkydistortion.jp/pc_english/story.html]Official site[/url]]
translation:
玩家扮演一名在原宿排练室工作的少女。她最喜欢的音乐是视觉系！！
她正是为了尽可能接近自己喜爱的音乐才选择这份工作，不过仍有许多东西要学。
一天，她遇见了一支名为DIS;CODE的四人视觉系乐队。
他们演奏出色，外形也无可挑剔！！但有一个问题：乐队没有主唱。
“你们不打算招人吗？”
这句话令玩家踏上了帮助乐队寻找主唱的旅程。

随后，乐队成员遇见了叶月。他虽是乐队新手，却有着极为独特的歌声。
玩家原以为成功找到主唱后便可以松一口气，事情却还没有结束！
“以后就请多关照了，专属经理！”
于是，她又阴差阳错地成了乐队的新任专属经理！

[摘自[url=http://www.pinkydistortion.jp/pc_english/story.html]官方网站[/url]]
